a: The bat riders' fire is a game object (spell 19629 summons 177764), so it shows as a trap rather than a spell target.
A dead high priest is resurrected after seven seconds unless the other two are dead too; all three must die inside one window.
Arlokk vanishes for half a minute and returns as a panther; while gone she leaves the mob list.
Gaze: the watched player must not move or act; a violation is a Decapitate. Player reports say damage-over-time ticks do not count.
Jin'do needs at least two players on his threat list or he resets.
Each Aspect is cast only while that high priest is alive; the panel cannot see which priests are dead.
Deep Breath is one of eight directional breath spells chosen from aMoveData; it has no timer so the panel shows no next window.
Version 1.18.1 adds a second dragon and Hatchers that are not in this script; they show only as mobs that carry a summoner.
Skeram splits at 75, 50 and 25 percent into himself and two images; the images have 10, 20 and then 50 percent of his health.
Earth Shock is cast only while his victim is out of melee reach; Arcane Explosion only while more players than allowed stand in melee reach.
The next Whirlwind timer starts when the 15 second Whirlwind ends; she goes berserk 10 minutes after the pull.
Entangle: three webs, each on a random player, inside a 45 second rotation; hatchlings spawn at the web the player was sent to.
Spawn of Fankriss: the first comes 20-30 s after the pull; each wave is 1-3 spawns 4-8 s apart, the next wave 18-37 s later; each spawn enrages after 15, 20 or 25 s.
Vek'lor takes no physical damage and Vek'nilash no spell damage; both teleport to swap places every 30-40 s.
The first three Eye Beams go to the puller, then to random targets; Dark Glare starts 45 s after the beam phase begins and lasts 38 s, and the next beam phase follows 1 s after it ends.
Phase 2: the first stomach grab comes 18 s minus the 3.25 s grab after he emerges, then every 10 s; killing both Flesh Tentacles in the stomach weakens him for 45 s.
Earthgrab Totem 8376 and Healing Ward 11899 share one EventAI timer: the first at 11.6 s, then every 13.3-21.7 s, one of the two chosen at random.
Four Sul'lithuz Broodlings 8138 spawn 3 s after the pull from four script summon commands; the three Hatchlings 8130 by his spawn are not attackable and are not adds.
Antu'sul's Minion 11894 is cast once at 75 percent (one Servant of Antu'sul 8156) and twice at 25 percent (two servants); the Servant is faction 107 and joins the fight.
Healing Wave of Antu'sul 11895 is cast once below 20 percent and then every 12 s below 30 percent; Flash Heal 10915 heals himself every 17-20 s below 60 percent; both are kickable.
creature_spells 81270 stores seconds: Fire Nova Totem 11314 first 7-11 s then every 10-13 s; Earth Shock 10413 first and every 7 s. Only one due spell is cast per 1.2 s update.
creature_spells 81560 stores seconds: Petrify 11020 first 5-16 s then every 22-36 s on the victim; it stuns and is magic, so it can be dispelled.
Antu'sul summons one servant at 75 percent and two at 25 percent; the servant is faction 107, joins the fight and is killed first.
creature_spells 72720 stores seconds: Fevered Plague 8600 first 15-18 s then every 10-22 s, only when the target has no Fevered Plague aura; the plague is a disease.

Theka Transform 11089 below 30 percent is a 30 s model change on the boss; it also applies a school immunity aura with misc values 1 and 32, so he is immune to physical and shadow for 30 s. He keeps fighting and no ability stops; the phase transform tracks the aura.

creature_spells 77950 stores seconds: Healing Wave 12491 every 9-22 s from the pull; Ward of Zum'rah 11086 first 2-5 s then every 13-28 s; Shadow Bolt Volley 15245 first 5-10 s then every 17-22 s; Shadow Bolt 12739 every 2 s at 90 percent chance.
The Ward of Zum'rah 7785 summons a Skeleton of Zum'rah 7786 every 5 s (11088); kill the Ward first.
Gahz'rilla is summoned by event 2488 when the Gong of Zul'Farrak is rung; his own 33007 sends event 2489, six one-second move commands that walk him out of the pit.

creature_spells 72730 stores seconds: Freeze Solid 11836 first and every 5-15 s on the second-highest aggro target (castTarget 2; the row keeps t=random because the table has no second-threat target); Slam 11902 first 3-10 s then every 3-10 s; Icicle 11131 first 7-20 s then every 7-20 s on a random player.
Slam knocks everyone within 9 yd into the air; Freeze Solid freezes its target; Icicle slows its target.

creature_spells 72710 stores seconds: Shadow Bolt 12739 every 3-5 s on a random player; Shadow Bolt Volley 15245 first 6-30 s then every 10-18 s; Ward of Zum'rah 11086 first 7-20 s then every 15-32 s; Healing Wave 12491 first 10-15 s then every 15-23 s on the most injured friendly below 40 percent.

Awaken Zul'Farrak Zombie 10731 runs 1-5 s after the pull and every 18 s after: it activates the nearest unopened 128403 grave within 100 yd, which releases a Zombie 7286 or a Dead Hero 7276 with no spell cast.
He is friendly until area trigger 962 fires. The Ward of Zum'rah 7785 summons a Skeleton of Zum'rah 7786 every 5 s (11088).

He stays friendly with a gossip menu until the fight option is taken; 10 s later he turns hostile and attacks the player who talked. Raven 7605, Oro Eyegouge 7606 and Murta Grimgut 7608 turn hostile; Weegli 7607 does not.
Shield Bash stuns its target and Revenge hits it; the script casts Revenge on a fixed timer although its comment says it should wait for a dodge or block.

Renew 11640 goes to the most injured friendly within 40 yd below 40 percent at 2.5 s then every 45-60 s; Heal 11642 goes to the same friendly at 4.1 s then every 45-60 s, and to himself below 50 percent every 10-12 s. Both are kickable; he is killed first.

Ruuzlu 7797 cleaves and executes a target below 20 percent; kill him first.
creature_spells 72740 stores seconds: Berserker Stance 7366 first 0-3 s then every 243 s; Cleave 15496 first 7-13 s then every 7-23 s.

Wave 3 spawns her with Nekrum Gutchewer 7796 and five Sandfury adds at the foot of the stairs; Nekrum is melee and dies first. She flees at 15 percent.
